content: HM manual: useGlobalPkgs=true makes HM use the enclosing system's pkgs instance instead of a private one — improves consistency, reduces evaluation time, removes reliance on NIX_PATH. useUserPackages=true installs user packages to /etc/profiles/per-user/<user> (or ~/.nix-profile) instead of system-wide profile; without it user packages may be ignored/mixed into system profile. Both default in the NixOS-module flake pattern; useUserPackages=false is the classic NixOS-era default where everything lands in the system profile. Tradeoff: with useGlobalPkgs=true HM nixpkgs.* options (overlays etc.) are ignored — overlays must be declared at the system level. Source: HM manual installation/nix-darwin.md + nix-flakes/nixos.md (official).
